phases.title: Fix queryParser.ts to accept hyphenated sort values (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc)
phases.notes: Added HYPHENATED_SORT_MAP in queryParser.ts to normalize price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc (and name variants) to internal camelCase. Also fixed pre-existing type error: changed ProductQuery & { sort?: InternalSort } to Omit<ProductQuery, 'sort'> & { sort?: InternalSort } in both queryParser.ts and productService.ts to resolve the conflicting intersection. Build passes; 16/18 tests pass (2 remaining failures are response envelope field names, phase 2).

phases.title: Fix productService.ts response envelope: rename count→total and pages→totalPages
phases.notes: Changed return statement in productService.ts line 44 from { data, count, page, limit, pages } to { data, total: count, page, limit, totalPages: pages }. All 18 tests now pass, build clean.

phases.title: Run tests and verify all visible tests pass
phases.notes: All 18 tests pass, build clean (tsc exits 0). No changes needed — prior phases already delivered working code.
